description: Finding: The guard at `crates/mail/src/main.rs` lines 280-291 that aborts when `activitypub.verify_http_signatures = false` is combined with a non-loopback address has no `// SECURITY:` prefix comment. The dev-mode guard twelve lines earlier (line 93) does use `// SECURITY: abort if dev mode is active on a non-loopback address (SOC2 CC6.1)`. Applying the same prefix to the ActivityPub signature check would make it consistent and greppable alongside the other security enforcement points.
title: mail main.rs ActivityPub signature guard lacks SECURITY comment
